Make no tool calls. Synthesize the audit using exactly these headings in order: LOCK STATUS; STOCK SOURCE; DIRECTIONS; THREE-PASS EDIT; TARGET AND MTP INTEGRITY; RECORDED EVIDENCE; HARNESS BOUNDARY; QUALIFICATION BOUNDARY; NEXT VALID ACTION.
